anna_ml: quick note from bring-up: magna-14B int4 streaming path diverges when resuming long prefixes (~4k tokens).
anna_ml: fp16 baseline matches reference; int4 shows small token substitutions starting around 4097-4100.
anna_ml: repro steps I used: `./bench_long_prefix --checkpoint v0.9 --resume --stream-cache` then append 500 tokens.
anna_ml: log extract:```
[stream] pos=4096 cache_idx=4096 sha1=3f8b2a...
[gen ] tok=4097 "the"
[stream] pos=4097 cache_idx=4096 sha1=3f8b2a...
[gen ] tok=4098 "then"
[stream] pos=4098 cache_idx=4098 sha1=9c1d7f...
```
sam_infra: are you on the packed-pipeline kernel or packed-v1? we rolled a stride calc tweak last week.
sam_infra: also did you flip the attention buffer flush optimization? that changes when we wrap the circular buffer.
anna_ml: packed-v1 + ATTN_BUFFER_FLUSH=1 by default. disabling flush moves onset to ~6k but doesn't remove it.
javier_research: hypothesis: quantized KV packing introduces tiny rounding that interacts with buffer indexing when tile boundaries align (seq_len % tile == 0). over many steps phase offset accumulates.
javier_research: if cache_idx aliasing happens, tensors at pos N and N+1 could point to same slot until a wrap, causing identical sha1 for consecutive positions then a jump.
tina_oncall: anna, please dump the raw KV sha1 at positions 4095..4100 for fp16/int4/packed-v0.9/v1. i'll run a dedicated bisect job.
anna_ml: pasted sha1s:```
fp16@4096: a1b2c3...
int4@4096: a1b2c3...
int4@4097: a1b2c3...
int4@4098: d4e5f6...
```
anna_ml: note int4 4096/4097 identical then flips at 4098.
sam_infra: that screams stride-off-by-one in the index math. quick local test: run with `--tile-size 128 --debug-stream` and set `STREAM_TILE_STRIDE=manual` to force explicit stride.
sam_infra: also reproduce on fp16 with the packed loading code disabled to rule out upstream packing bug.
javier_research: i'd run fp16, int8, int4 to measure error growth curve. if int8 shows milder drift vs int4, confirms quant amplification.
tina_oncall: scheduling Dedicated slot now for bisect (ETA ~12m). deploy-bot: queued job dedicated/magna-1 id=987654999.
deploy-bot: job started id=987654999.
anna_ml: ran the small-tile experiment locally: with tile-size=128 the issue didn't appear in 10k tokens. with 256 it reproduced at ~4097.
sam_infra: good signal. that isolates tile-size math. pls try the kernel v0.9 binary; if v0.9 is clean it's a recent regression.
javier_research: mitigation ideas if we confirm: 1) make circular buffer use absolute monotonic positions for mapping; 2) pad pseudo-guard tokens so wraps never occur on boundary; 3) fallback: on resume verify KV checksum and if mismatch, rehydrate the next N tokens in fp16 then switch back to quant.
tina_oncall: Dedicated run completed: fp16 ok, int8 OOMed on packed-v1 job, int4 reproducible failure on packed-v1. artifacts: `/artifacts/987654999/stream-debug.log`
anna_ml: thanks, downloading logs now. int4 packed-v0.9 run from javier repro script appears clean. so regression between v0.9->v1 packing stride.
sam_infra: opening kernel bisect issue. i'll revert the stride change on a feature branch and run regression tests.
javier_research: i'll draft an eval to compare token-level perplexity drift over long prefixes across quant levels to quantify impact.
tina_oncall: i'll submit a short PR that adds checksum divergence alerting and the fp16 rehydrate fallback for resume paths (short-term mitigation).
anna_ml: ordering for follow-ups: sam bisect + revert candidate, tina PR for fallback, javier to run quant-drift eval, i'll update the model bring-up checklist to block packed-v1 until fix.
anna_ml: adding minimal diff artifact for downstream infra and product to see if any user-facing failures occurred. :thumbsup:
